# Talery App Screenshots

Add your UI screenshot images here with the following filenames. The website's Screenshots section will display them inside phone frames.

## Required Files

| Filename | Screenshot Description |
|----------|------------------------|
| `trip-settings.jpg` | Trip Settings screen (Meghalaya by @mithun_travels) |
| `thailand-map.jpg` | Thailand map with cities: Chiang Mai, Bangkok, Pattaya, Phuket, Krabi, Koh Samui |
| `city-selection.jpg` | City search/selection: Bangkok, Phuket, Chiang Mai, Krabi with flags |
| `bangkok-itinerary.jpg` | Bangkok itinerary with map and "Ask Talery (AI)" suggestions |
| `add-location.jpg` | Add a location screen with suggested Bangkok places |
| `saved-places.jpg` | Saved places list: Wat Arun, The Siam Hotel, Thipsamai Pad Thai, etc. |
| `route-map.jpg` | Route map showing Bangkok → Phuket with numbered pins |
| `add-stay.jpg` | Add Stay screen with hotel search and saved places |
| `day-planning.jpg` | Day planning timeline with activities and map route |
| `profile-trips.jpg` | Profile screen: aditya dhal with upcoming/past trips |

## Notes

- Accepted formats: `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.png`, `.webp`
- For best results, use portrait phone screenshots with a 9:19.5 aspect ratio
- If you prefer different filenames, update `app/sections/Screenshots.tsx` accordingly
- After adding images, run `npm run build` and restart the local server
